report.model_summary: Inpatient cost for Nov 2009 rose from $1,269,800 ($131.31 PMPM reported and correct) to $1,720,800 ($177.95 PMPM reported and correct), a real +$451,000 (+$46.64 PMPM, +36%). Denominator held at 9,670 member-months. Growth is late adjudication: pending Nov claims fell from 17 to 1 while paid claims grew 144 to 179 with reversals correctly netted (-$6.0M), no duplicates or boundary errors, averages stable.

Denominator held at 9,670 member-months. events.brief: November 2009 inpatient PMPM increased genuinely from $131.31 to $177.95 (+$46.64), as paid inpatient cost rose from $1,269,800 to $1,720,800 (+$451,000) on a constant 9,670 member-months. This reflects late adjudication of November claims rather than a reporting error, so no SQL or denominator correction is required.
